findings.title: pre-edit.sh names .claude/rules/ as the source of .cursor/rules and sends seats to edit a generated copy
findings.claim: pre-edit.sh's header (line 14) and its .cursor/rules refusal (lines 94-97) say the Cursor rules are generated from .claude/rules/ and tell the seat to edit that source and regenerate, but rules_sync.mjs generates both .claude/rules/ and .cursor/rules/ from dev/governance/rules/, so an edit made where the hook says is discarded by the regeneration (edit_reaches_cursor=0) and the hook lets that generated directory through (unguarded_generated=1).
findings.mechanism: R9-RO-5 moved the canonical rules to dev/governance/rules/ and made .claude/rules/ a second generated output (tools/policy/rules_sync.mjs SRC/CLAUDE_OUT/CURSOR_OUT); the hook's comment, refusal text and guard still describe the pre-move layout, and its self-test pins the stale reading ('the SOURCE rule is allowed', .claude/rules/gate-scoping.md).

findings.title: text_ledger scan_c_like reports wrong line numbers for 1175 of 1899 JS comment units
findings.claim: tools/audit/text_ledger.py:scan_c_like loses one line each time a non-template string literal stops at a newline (break before line += 1, i = j + 1 consumes it), so the `line` column of 1175 of the seat's 1899 JavaScript comment units does not hold the unit's text (tests/card.mjs 690, policy_lint.mjs 353); Python units, numbered by tokenize, are 0 of 1200.
findings.mechanism: A quote inside a regex literal or a stray apostrophe opens a 'string' that ends at the newline; the newline is skipped without counting; the error accumulates down the file (card.mjs's DESIGN.md unit reports 10542, the text is at 10605). Ids are hashes, so `check` still passes and the defect is silent; a seat or fixer walking to a ledger row lands on the wrong code.
